drug_class: Skeletal muscle relaxant; GABA-B receptor agonist

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk; both agents suppress muscle tone and neural activity
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on CNS depression risks

avoid_supplements.name: GHB (Gamma-hydroxybutyrate)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Both are GABA-B agonists; severe additive CNS depression, respiratory depression, and overdose risk
avoid_supplements.action: Absolutely contraindicated; educate patient on serious overdose potential

caution_supplements.name: Valerian root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild additive CNS depression; may enhance sedation or dizziness
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive CNS depression; advise caution with dosing timing

caution_supplements.name: Passionflower
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild GABAergic activity; potential additive CNS effects
caution_supplements.action: Counsel on increased sedation risk; monitor tolerance

caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: May reduce baclofen efficacy through unclear mechanisms; potential mood interaction
caution_supplements.action: Monitor clinical response; consider alternative mood support if needed

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Potent additive CNS depression; significantly increases risk of sedation, dizziness, impaired cognition, and motor control impairment
caution_foods.action: Strongly advise abstinence or minimal consumption; counsel on impaired driving/machinery operation risk

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May affect fluid retention and electrolyte balance; minimal direct interaction but relevant to renal function monitoring
caution_foods.action: Encourage moderate sodium intake; monitor fluid status if renal impairment present

monitoring_notes: Baclofen undergoes minimal hepatic metabolism and is primarily renally excreted, limiting typical CYP-mediated interactions. Monitor for CNS depression signs (sedation, dizziness, ataxia) when combined with other depressants; assess renal function periodically as dose adjustment may be needed with declining renal clearance.
